mapper.select: SELECT id, club_id, category, title, content, owner_id, source_concept_id, source_user_id, status, created_at FROM experience_entry WHERE status = 1 AND (club_id = #{clubId} OR club_id IS NULL) AND ( (category = 'thinking_pattern' AND owner_id = #{userId}) OR category != 'thinking_pattern' ) AND (#{q} IS NULL OR #{q} = '' OR title ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR content ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM experience_entry WHERE status = 1 AND (club_id = #{clubId} OR club_id IS NULL) AND category != 'thinking_pattern'
